border-radius.$description: The one corner radius of the design system: cards, boxes, photos, alerts and buttons.

border-radius-sm.$description: Kept equal to the default radius, so no component has a smaller corner.

border-radius-lg.$description: Kept equal to the default radius, so no component has a larger corner.

border-radius-xl.$description: Kept equal to the default radius.

border-radius-xxl.$description: Kept equal to the default radius.

headings-font-weight.$description: Weight of every heading, so a section title reads the same everywhere.
